x: A little excitement was generated on the final leg by Newham's Andy Robinson pulling back the Aldershot man to go into bronze medal position.

The wind had made a mockery of the times but there was no doubt that it was a terrific run from Phil who was just three seconds down on Andy Robinson and ahead of Dave Mitchison (both Beagles) and Cole (Medway & Maidstone).

Above: A mile gone in the men’s race and Barry Royden (847 Medway & Maidstone) holds a narrow lead with Matt Ashton (3 Aldershot F&D), Darren Deed (61 Bedford &C) and Phil Wicks (100 Belgrave) in echelon. Just behind Royden is Huw Lobb (Bedford), Dominic Bannister (Shaftesbury) and Andy Robinson (Newham & Essex Beagles).

So Neil’s final attack for the Bels was reserved for Newham & Essex Beagles who had threatened to win at one point before finally finishing the race out of the hardware. Pity poor Beagle Andy Robinson, far from his fittest and having to face such an onslaught.
